head.name: @fzlt/core/rules
head.lead: The rules every arcade game repeats, as three small systems on the kernel: - waves: a wave clock, prepare → assault → rebuild, with a spawn budget per wave; - drops: pickups that fall, wait to be collected and expire; - score: points, a combo that decays, and levels from XP thresholds. Each is DOM-free, steps without allocating (state lives in typed arrays) and says what happened on the event ring (wave:start, wave:clear, drop:spawn, drop:land, drop:collect, drop:expire, score, combo:end, level), so the HUD, sound, fx and coach layers react without reaching into the game. Defaults are the DOM VIRUS core's (WaveDirector, SupplyDrops) and Null Invaders' numbers, so a port keeps its feel. The game still decides where and what to spawn. Call collect, add and miss from a step, like the rest of the game: their events go on that frame's ring.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
